verdict.rationale: Data export applies to an online IP-office service: DPMA runs filing portals (DPMAdirektWeb/Pro) and public databases (DPMAregister, DEPATISnet) that could offer bulk or user-data export in open formats. The evidence only describes search, filing routes and paper/electronic submission. Nothing documents exporting a user's filings or register data in open formats or leaving the service. The robots.txt probe concerns crawler access, not user data export, so it is not relevant.
